content.text: Great question! Think of Sui like having multiple racecar lanes instead of a single highway. Transactions don’t get stuck in traffic—they happen in parallel. Perfect for degens who want instant trades and unstoppable speed.
Should I buy Sui tokens now?

I can’t give financial advice, but I can say the network is built to handle massive throughput. Always do your own research and consider the risks. If you do decide to jump in, at least you won’t be waiting in slow transaction queues!
